description.name: Entry
description.text: One single attack (39.60) capped at 99999, causes [Poison] (15%), [Blind] (15%), [Silence] (15%) and [Confuse] (15%)

description.name: Poison
description.text: Damages for 1/64 maximum HP every 5.00 seconds, persists after battle

description.name: Blind
description.text: ACC -50%, reduces hit rate by 75%, persists after battle, base duration is 30 seconds for characters

description.name: Silence
description.text: Disables BLK, WHT, BLU and SUM actions, persists after battle

description.name: Confuse
description.text: Forces default action (Attack for characters), affects targeting (single: 50% random enemy, 50% random ally; group: 50% all enemies, 50% all allies), resets ATB when set or removed, removed upon taking damage by PHY attacks
